literature_notes: ASIC2 (UniProt Q16515) is a two-pass membrane protein with topology: intracellular N-terminus (1–42), TM1 (43–59), large extracellular domain (60–434), TM2 (435–455), intracellular C-terminus (456–512). All five ledger lines describe tags at one of the two cytoplasmic termini. L1 and L3 (PMC4967927) report GFP/mCherry fused to the N-terminus (pEGFP-C1 / mCherry-C1 vectors = tag precedes the insert, i.e. GFP-ASIC2) and to the C-terminus (pEGFP-N1 = ASIC2-GFP); both termini are intracellular. L2 (PMC4967927) reports HA-ASIC2a/b immunostaining for subcellular localisation; the 'HA-' prefix indicates an N-terminal fusion, which is intracellular. L4 (PMC3390797) reports N-terminal YFP (pEYFP-C1) and N-terminal FLAG (pFLAG-CMV-2) fusions; again intracellular. L5 (PMC13273826) reports a C-terminal HA tag on ASIC2aG430V; the C-terminus (456–512) is intracellular. No ledger line reports any insertion in the extracellular domain (60–434). Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused to the N-terminus of full-length ASIC2a/2b (residues 1–42 are intracellular per topology landmarks); used to study subcellular localisation, not a surface-accessible site.
N-terminal FLAG tag (pFLAG-CMV-2) and N-terminal YFP (pEYFP-C1) on full-length ASIC2a/2b; N-terminus is intracellular (residues 1–42).
HA epitope tag inserted at the C-terminus of ASIC2aG430V; C-terminus (residues 456–512) is intracellular per topology landmarks.
